issues.title: Its check for walls around a room fails on Build 42.22
issues.note: It asks a tile for its wall flags with get(IsoFlagType...), which 42.22 does not take (the game's own code uses has): "No implementation found for function: get(...PropertyContainer..., IsoFlagType WallN)". That check (also reached from its heat simulation, logged as checkpoint) stops with an error each time; the rest of the mod goes on. Nothing to fix from here: its author has to change those calls (12 of them).
issues.log: ERROR: General      f:3> Lua((MOD:Realistic Temperature)).edgeHasBlockingOnSquare> Exception thrown
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, game log: in 8 of 14 sessions with the mod on 42.22.2 (2026-11-16 and 17); the 2.4.0 copy Steam installed on 2026-11-17 still has the call at line 439 (12 calls in two files)
